cx.rmDrillTcDark: While luring boar or pushing deer, tap your Select TC + Villager hotkey every 15s without moving the camera.
cx.rmDrillFeudal: Drill a clean 20–21 pop build in Build Orders and avoid queuing extra villagers once you hit 500 food.
cx.rmDrillDba: Fixed rule on hitting Feudal: select Lumber Camp → Double-Bit Axe before microing your first military unit.
cx.rmDrillTcGap: During Feudal skirmishes, weave 1 blind Select All TCs + Villager tap after every 2 army micro clicks.
cx.rmDrillBowSaw: As soon as Castle Age finishes: Lumber Camp → Bow Saw before dropping TCs or microing to sustain farm wood.
cx.rmDrillMarketWood: In Castle Age, whenever wood exceeds 350 without saving for University or TC, grab 4 lumberjacks and seed 4 farms.
cx.rmDrillUpgrades: Before taking your first major Castle Age fight, verify +2 armor on cavalry/infantry or Bodkin Arrow on archers.
cx.rmDrillMicroCtrl: In fights of 10+ units avoid right-clicking single soldiers: use Patrol or Attack-Move behind the enemy line.
cx.rmDrillTownBell: Unbind Town Bell: box-select only the threatened villagers and press Garrison (G) on the nearest TC.
cx.rmDrillEapm: Use control groups (1 Main Army, 2 Support) and Select All TCs/Military hotkeys to cycle production without panning.
cx.rmDrillLateClosing: In Imperial reach 130–140 villagers, secure Trebuchets/Cannons first, and add 6–8 production buildings near key castles.
cx.rmDrillVsTarget: Against higher-ELO rivals avoid passive play: stick to your top 2 civs and pressure exposed resources in Feudal.
cx.rmDrillColdStart: Before queuing your first ranked game of the day, run two 30s rounds in the APM Trainer to warm up hands and reads.
cx.rmDrillFatigue: Cap ranked blocks at 3 consecutive games or take a 10-minute break away from the screen before queuing game #4.
cx.rmDrillMapLeak: Ban this map in ladder vetoes or prepare a dedicated specialist civ build order in Build Orders.
